The issuer shows acceptable liquidity (current assets of 1,536M vs. current liabilities of 539M) and solid capitalization (equity of 2,427M), but operating performance is very weak with a large EBIT/operating loss of -988M against revenue of 2,325M, indicating significant earnings pressure. Leverage is moderately high (total liabilities of 3,451M exceed equity), supporting a speculative-grade rating rather than investment grade.  

DECISION: B+
